correctness.rationale: The Markov increments exhaust the birth-event possibilities; direct substitution and unique polynomial recurrence prove the bivariate generating function. Independent Bernoulli marking gives the exact stopped negative-binomial law. The martingale residual has conditional variance q*C_n/(p*n), yielding the exact second moment; the Yule embedding and a bounded-increment stable martingale CLT prove the strong and Gaussian limits. Replayed 883 exact finite checks confirm recurrence, moments, PGF coefficients and small-tree enumeration. Infinite proofs do not depend on enumeration.

value.rationale: In the contracted percolation-component tree, B_n is exactly the root degree: a natural structural branching statistic not recoverable from the size-weighted descendant count. The exact joint generating function, finite-size residual variance and unconditional/observed-size Gaussian limits describe a genuine mechanism of fluctuations, including dependence on the random root-size limit. The first-passage negative-binomial law additionally relates growth and boundary creation.
